crossRefs.note: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

people.name: Kiriathaim
people.line: A Moabite city, later allotted to Reuben

people.name: Sibmah
people.line: Moabite town known for its vineyards

people.name: Zereth-shahar
people.line: A city in Reuben's territory by the Dead Sea

translations.web: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
translations.bsb: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley,
translations.kjv: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
translations.asv: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
